name: Notion
description: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, and project management

research.summary: Notion is a versatile productivity platform combining notes, docs, wikis, and project management. It uses a block-based editor with real-time collaboration, supports databases with multiple views, and integrates AI features across the platform.

raw_findings.name: Notion
raw_findings.summary: Notion is a versatile productivity platform.
raw_findings.notable_patterns: Uses OAuth2 for integrations, API key access for developers, rate limits on API at 3 requests per second

verifications.evidence: Verified via job listings and tech stack analysis

research.summary: Figma is a cloud-based design tool enabling real-time collaboration on user interfaces. It runs entirely in the browser using WebGL and WebAssembly for high-performance rendering, with a Rust-based compiler for the rendering engine.

raw_findings.name: Figma
raw_findings.notable_patterns: Uses OAuth2 for integrations, API key access for plugins, no public webhooks, rate limits apply

verifications.claim: Figma uses Rust for rendering engine

research.summary: Slack is a team communication platform offering channels, direct messaging, and integrations with hundreds of services. It provides a robust API and app platform for extending functionality.

raw_findings.name: Slack
raw_findings.summary: Team communication platform with channels and integrations.
raw_findings.notable_patterns: Uses OAuth2 for app authentication, webhooks for events, API rate limits at tier-based levels, approval required for enterprise features

name: Linear
description: Modern issue tracking for software teams

research.summary: Linear is a streamlined issue tracking tool focused on speed and keyboard-driven workflows. Built with a modern stack emphasizing real-time sync and opinionated project management.

raw_findings.name: Linear
raw_findings.summary: Modern issue tracking focused on speed.
raw_findings.notable_patterns: Uses API key authentication, webhooks available, self-serve sign up with free tier

verifications.evidence: DNS and deployment analysis confirms Vercel

name: Supabase
description: Open source Firebase alternative with Postgres

research.summary: Supabase is an open-source backend-as-a-service providing a Postgres database, authentication, real-time subscriptions, storage, and edge functions. It positions itself as a Firebase alternative with full SQL capabilities.

raw_findings.name: Supabase
raw_findings.notable_patterns: Fully open source, self-serve with generous free tier, API key and JWT authentication, webhooks and real-time subscriptions

verifications.claim: Supabase is open source with Postgres

verifications.evidence: Verified via source code and job listings
